## 微软 FY26 Q4 Intelligent Cloud 分部分析

### 1. 本季度收入同比增长

**计算过程：**

| 项目 | FY26 Q4 (Three Months Ended June 30, 2026) | FY25 Q4 (Three Months Ended June 30, 2025) | 出处 |
|---|---|---|---|
| Intelligent Cloud 收入 | $39,306 million | $29,878 million | financial_statements.txt + press_release.txt（位置 3115 附近） |

**计算公式：**

同比增长率 = (39,306 − 29,878) / 29,878 × 100
= 9,428 / 29,878 × 100
= **31.56%**

管理层公布口径为 **32%**（按 GAAP 四舍五入），按恒定汇率口径为 **31%**（press_release.txt 位置 3115）。

---

### 2. 管理层在电话会上对增长的归因（原文引用）

以下全部出自 `transcript.txt` 第 24890–24930 字符区域（电话会 Q4 FY26 业绩回顾段落）：

> **归因 A — Azure 需求超供给：** "Customer demand continues to exceed available capacity."

> **归因 B — 算力效率提升：** "Revenue growth was ahead of expectations driven by efficiency gains across our CPU and GPU fleet as well as process improvements to enable earlier delivery of new capacity."

> **归因 C — 新增产能快速变现：** "That additional in-quarter capacity for Azure was quickly monetized."

> **归因 D — GitHub Copilot 消费超预期：** "Results also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption following the June business model change to align pricing with usage and value."

> **归因 E — 本地服务器续约：** "In our on-premises server business, revenue was relatively unchanged year-over-year and was down 1% in constant currency. Results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition from the mix of contracts."

---

### 3. 归因的事实/前瞻性区分

| 归因 | 性质 | 判定依据 |
|---|---|---|
| **A. 客户Demand超过可用产能** | **已发生的事实** | 使用现在进行时 "continues to exceed"，描述 Q4 实际观察到的市场状态，是已发生现象的陈述 |
| **B. CPU/GPU 算力效率提升 + 流程改进使新产能提前交付** | **已发生的事实** | 使用过去时 "was ahead of expectations driven by…"，描述 Q4 期间实际发生的效率改进和产能交付 |
| **C. 新增产能被快速变现** | **已发生的事实** | "was quickly monetized" — 过去时，描述 Q4 内已经实现的收入转化 |
| **D. GitHub Copilot 消费超预期** | **已发生的事实** | "also benefited from stronger-than-expected GitHub Copilot consumption" — 描述 Q4 实际观察到的消费结果；虽提及 "June business model change" 这一已发生事件，但消费超预期是 Q4 已确认的结果 |
| **E. 本地服务器续约的 in-period 收入确认** | **已发生的事实** | "results were ahead of expectations primarily driven by renewals with higher in-period revenue recognition" — 描述 Q4 实际出现的合同续约和确认时点效应 |

**结论：** 全部五条归因描述的都是 **已经发生的事实**，没有使用 "we expect"、"we anticipate"、"will continue to" 等前瞻性表述。电话会在该段落之后以 "Now, moving to our outlook" 作为分界线进入前瞻性指引，因此此前所有描述均属于对 Q4 已实现结果的复盘。

**补充说明：** 在后续 outlook 段落中（transcript.txt 位置 32535 之后），管理层对 FY27 给出了前瞻性表述，例如 "we expect FX to decrease total revenue growth by less than 1 point"、"we expect revenue of $40.95 to $41.25 billion, or growth of 33% to 34%" 等。这些属于未来导向，不属于对 Q4 已发生增长的归因。
